description:
The type taxonomy carries an error enum whose only constructed variant every caller discards, an error variant nothing constructs, and a test-only membership checker with its validation-issue variant.

## Background

In `crates/jit/src/domain/type_taxonomy.rs`:

- `HierarchyError` (`:66-74`). Its `InvalidLabel` variant is constructed by `extract_type` (`:231`), whose callers (`:330,377,426`) all discard the error with `Err(_)`. `UnknownType` is never constructed (`allow(dead_code)` at `:69`). Tests are at `:657-676`.
- `ConfigError::DuplicateType` (`:128`, `allow(dead_code)`) is never constructed.
- `detect_membership_issues` (`:478`, `allow(dead_code)`) has only test callers: the whole of `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/label_membership_validation_tests.rs` (10 tests, declared at `fast_rules/main.rs:14`). It is the only constructor of `ValidationIssue::InvalidMembershipReference` (`:86`, built at `:527,550`). That variant is matched in `generate_fixes` (`:599`) and in `commands/validate.rs:1509`.

Production checks membership references through rule label-reference assertions in `validation/graph.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `HierarchyError` no longer exists, and `extract_type` returns an `Option`.
- [hard] REQ-02: `ConfigError::DuplicateType` no longer exists.
- [hard] REQ-03: `detect_membership_issues`, `ValidationIssue::InvalidMembershipReference` and their match arms no longer exist, and the membership validation test file is deleted.
- [hard] REQ-04: The taxonomy module holds no `allow(dead_code)` on an error type or validation function.

## Notes

The orphan-validation code in the same module is unaffected.
title: Remove dead taxonomy error and membership types
